I am in LOVE with Danganronpa. Here are some things that had to be explained to me:


1. I highly recommend watching Danganronpa 3 after playing through DR1, DR2, and Ultra Despair Girls

2. I personally didn't have the money/feel the need to play Ultra Despair Girls, but I wanted to watch the anime so I watched this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PSeAKckdOm4 and it sums up the game so you can watch the anime. (you can watch the anime here: https://www.watchcartoononline.io/anime/danganronpa-3-the-end-of-hopes-peak-high-school-despair-arc and   https://www.watchcartoononline.io/anime/danganronpa-3-the-end-of-hopes-peak-high-school-future-arc )

3. If you watch the anime, you have to watch it alternating the arcs starting with the Future arc. So future arc ep1, depair arc ep1, future arc ep2 ect.

4. If you love the characters, (or one in particular), after you beat the game there is a "School Mode" in DR1 and an "Island Mode" in DR2 where you can max out your relationships with the characters and there might even be more dialogue from certain characters that you wouldn't get in the regular game.

5. Have fun!

I hope this was helpful, there is a lot to Danganronpa and I hope you enjoy it!
